# arif-fazil.com — machine-readable index

## Role
Human-first professional homepage for Muhammad Arif bin Fazil (Arif Fazil), a Malaysian exploration geoscientist and creator of arifOS.

## The Sovereign (Ψ SOUL)
Arif Fazil is a Senior Exploration Geoscientist specializing in full-spectrum subsurface strategy and risk under uncertainty. He has made material contributions to major discoveries in offshore Malaysia (BEKANTAN-1, PUTERI BASEMENT-1, LEBAH EMAS-1). He is the creator of arifOS, a constitutional AI governance kernel designed to enforce "adult supervision" for agents in high-stakes environments.

## The Federation Architecture (ΔΩΨ)
- Ψ SOUL: Human intent and values (arif-fazil.com)
- Ω MIND: Constitutional law and invariants (arifos.arif-fazil.com)
- Δ BODY: Machine execution and tools (aaa.arif-fazil.com)
